summary.en: BSF troops shot dead a Pakistani intruder attempting to cross the border in Punjab, while Pakistani soldiers were attacked in Balochistan, resulting in four deaths and seven injuries. The UK Army Chief visited the Pakistan-Afghanistan border amid regional security tensions, and Saudi and Turkish officials arrived in Pakistan for trilateral defence talks linked to the Saudi-Houthi escalation in Yemen, where a Saudi aircraft struck a residential building in Taiz. Taliban forces in Afghanistan killed six young men from Panjshir after they failed to stop at a checkpoint, and Pakistan downed a Taliban drone that violated its airspace. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: BSF-troppene skjøt en pakistansk inntrenger som forsøkte å krysse grensen i Punjab, mens pakistanske soldater ble angrepet i Balochistan, noe som resulterte i fire døde og sju sårede. Den britiske hærens sjef besøkte Pakistan-Afghanistan-grensen midt i regionale sikkerhetsspenn, og saudiske og tyrkiske tjenestemenn ankom Pakistan for trilaterale forsvarssamtaler knyttet til den saudisk-houthi-opptrappingen i Jemen, hvor et saudi-fly traff en boligblokk i Taiz. Taliban-styrkene i Afghanistan drepte seks unge menn fra Panjsjher etter at de ikke stoppet ved en kontrollpost, og Pakistan skjøt ned en Taliban-drone som brøt inn i luftrommet. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
